title: Create in Me a Clean Heart

questions.question: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:1 (ESV): "Have mercy on me, O God, according to your steadfast love;"

questions.question: According to your abundant mercy blot out my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:1 (ESV): "...according to your abundant mercy blot out my transgressions."

questions.question: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:2 (ESV): "Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin!"

questions.question: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is ever before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:3 (ESV): "For I know my transgressions, and my sin is ever before me."

questions.question: Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:4 (ESV): "Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your sight,"

questions.question: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin did my mother do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:5 (ESV): "Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin did my mother conceive me."

questions.question: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:7 (ESV): "Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow."

questions.question: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right what within me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:10 (ESV): "Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me."

questions.question: Cast me not away from your presence, and take not your Holy Spirit from whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:11 (ESV): "Cast me not away from your presence, and take not your Holy Spirit from me."

questions.question: Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and uphold me with a willing what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:12 (ESV): "Restore to me the joy of your salvation, and uphold me with a willing spirit."

questions.question: For you will not delight in sacrifice, or I would give it; you will not be pleased with a burnt what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:16 (ESV): "For you will not delight in sacrifice, or I would give it; you will not be pleased with a burnt offering."

questions.question: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:17 (ESV): "a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise."

questions.question: Do good to Zion in your good pleasure; build up the walls of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:18 (ESV): "Do good to Zion in your good pleasure; build up the walls of Jerusalem;"

questions.question: Then you will delight in right sacrifices, in burnt offerings and whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51:19 (ESV): "...then bulls will be offered on your altar."

questions.question: This Psalm was written after who came to David?
questions.explanation: Psalm 51 Title: "...when Nathan the prophet went to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba."

key_verse_text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
